description: This Java class converts a map of query parameters into a map of header key-value pairs based on configuration settings. It implements the UnaryOperator interface to process query parameters, primarily used to adapt query params into headers as specified by HttpConfig.

classes.name: QueryParametersToHeadersMap
classes.description: Immutable class implementing UnaryOperator to convert query parameters map to header map according to configuration.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of QueryParametersToHeadersMap based on provided HttpConfig.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Converts a map of query parameters into headers based on the defined set of HeaderDefinitions.
